title: 1998冬，机床边的名字
logline: 1998年冬国营机床厂，顾长根发现徒弟大刘偷换转岗名单，师徒机床边的争执道出两代工人的坚守，传递机器不停人就得往前的信念。

shots.narrationZh: 九八冬，国营机床厂的汽笛刚歇。
shots.narrationEn: Winter 1998, the whistle of the state-owned machine tool factory just faded.
shots.visual: Frosted high windows of the 1990s state-owned workshop, rows of old machine tools lined up, pale snow light seeping through the glass, faint machine hum and broadcast static in the background.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉缓低语，带金属寒意的厚重感，尾音稍沉，「九八冬」轻顿，气息平稳铺陈年代氛围

shots.visual: Gu Changgen in dark blue factory uniform with matching sleeve covers and a low-pressed cap holds a crumpled transfer list by a dented metal tool cabinet, his grease-stained fingers gripping the paper tightly, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 大刘，你动这转岗名单作甚？
lines.en: Liu, why did you touch this transfer list?

shots.ttsDirection: 压嗓低诉，语速缓滞，「五十」二字稍重，喉间带颤，气息沉在胸口，透出无奈与执拗

shots.visual: Da Liu in the same dark blue uniform with sleeves rolled up, short black hair, stands by the running old lathe, his Adam's apple bobbing as he speaks, a faint scar visible on the back of his hand, the workshop broadcast speaker mounted on the wall behind him.

lines.en: I'm young, I should take this post.

shots.ttsDirection: 声音发紧，语速稍快，尾音刻意压稳，「二十五」轻顿，气息短促，藏着小心的倔强

shots.visual: Gu Changgen steps closer to the lathe, visible breath fogging in the cold winter air, his gaze fixed on Da Liu, the faint sound of the workshop broadcast mixing with the low hum of machines.

lines.zh: 我五十了你是二十五，厂里养过我全家。
lines.en: I'm fifty, you're twenty-five. The factory raised my whole family.

shots.ttsDirection: 压嗓低吼，语速加快，「厂里养过我全家」重读，气息猛地沉下去，带压抑的怒意与恳求

shots.narrationZh: 机器不停，人就得往前走。我们机床，伴匠人前行。
shots.narrationEn: Machines never stop, so must we. Our machine tools, accompanies craftsmen forward.
shots.visual: The camera pans from the old lathe where the two stand to a brand new CNC machine tool placed at the corner of the workshop, the low hum of running machines filling the space.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳有力，语速放缓，「机器不停」「往前走」重读，气息沉而稳，尾音带金属回响般的厚重，收束全片情绪
